page.overview:
Who is Maximus Octavian Grüber III?

Maximus Octavian Grüber III was an aristocratic and arrogant general of the Cadian Shock Trooper regiments of the Astra Militarum. It was Grüber who commanded the contingent of Cadian troops that survived the Fall of Cadia during the 13th Black Crusade and led a heroic last stand against the forces of Chaos during the Battle of Faith's Anchorage that marked the start of the successful Imperial campaign to retake the Agripinaa System from the Archenemy.

Prior to the Fall of Cadia, Grüber had served in the Deucalion Crusade, which was among the many campaigns he had fought in his hundred-and-fifty-standard-year career in the Astra Militarum. However Grüber had ascended on the backs of the countless Cadian Guardsmen he had sent unnecessarily to their deaths and he had little compunction about wasting lives if it meant advancing his own ambitions. When Cadia was invaded by the forces of Chaos during the 13th Black Crusade, Grüber was a member of the Cadian high command and led the Astra Militarum's 17th Army from an area known as Bastion 8.

As the invasion wore on, Grüber was one of the few Imperial general officers to still command his given region, which he did with discipline, a stubborn lack of imagination and thirty miles of minefields. However he was forced to leave Bastion 8 when Lord Castellan Ursarkar E. Creed ordered a massive counter-attack against the Chaos invaders. This counter-offensive irritated Grüber, as he was not sure he could successfully lead his forces in the series of attacks that was asked of him. Worse, he feared that ever since the lowborn upstart Creed had became Lord Castellan of Cadia, his charisma and military genius had changed the way Cadians expected to be led. Grüber knew it was no longer enough for him to be authoritative, professional and stern. His Guardsmen now looked for him to inspire them like Creed had, but though he tried, Gruber simply lacked his rival's charisma and he was forced to repeatedly use Creed's name to keep up their enthusiasm and excitement for the campaign to come.

During the planned counter-attack, Abaddon the Despoiler unleashed the remains of his Blackstone Fortress the Will of Eternity to descend like a meteor, striking the surface of the Fortress World and dooming it in the cataclysm that followed. The Imperial forces were ordered to evacuate before Cadia was rent apart by tectonic instability. In the mass panic and confusion that followed, Grüber stayed to personally supervised the evacuation of most of his forces. But once their window to escape began to close, he agreed to board the last evacuation craft and joined the Imperial fleet as it began its escape from the Cadian System.
